field_principles.MODEL_SPECS: Models actually invoked; use an empty list when no LLM runs.
field_principles.acceptance_gate_results: Keep each frozen criterion, actual value, and pass state separate.
field_principles.arm_contract: Bind the six frozen arms and their shared observable feedback budget.
field_principles.causal_summary: Separate reactivation, later-change, pre-release, and headroom counts.
field_principles.comparison_rows: Use paired seed differences and frozen 10,000-draw bootstrap intervals.
field_principles.completed_at_utc: Keep the actual UTC end separate from the fixed execution date.
field_principles.continuous_learning_counts: Report additions, deactivations, and validated reactivations.
field_principles.continuous_self_learning_task: True; constraints can be added, deactivated, and reactivated.
field_principles.current_generation_count: Count only generations performed by this run.
field_principles.current_inference_count: Count only inference calls performed by this run.
field_principles.current_model_load_count: Count only model loads performed by this run.
field_principles.decision_rows_path: The raw JSONL keeps each pre-release prediction and later label.
field_principles.duration_s: Measure monotonic elapsed work and record phase spans separately.
field_principles.e2e_control_summary: Require rejected writes, fresh restore, and byte-identical rollback.
field_principles.evidence_manifest_path: Keep historical sources and synthetic negative controls in a sidecar.
field_principles.execution_host: Record the actual hostname separately from the execution venue.
field_principles.execution_venue: Top-level orchestration is host; board rows name a board venue.
field_principles.experiment_id: A fixed identifier prevents another task from supplying this result.
field_principles.family_retired: An inconclusive null does not retire the constraint family.
field_principles.field_principles: Keep ordinary values at top level; put their explanations in this map.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Name failed check, upstream, field, expected value, and observed value.
field_principles.honest_verdict: A completed finding starts complete_; an external absence starts blocked_.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Use the recognized literal for the operation actually executed.
field_principles.inference_substrate_class: The actual class determines the duration floor; never pad duration.
field_principles.latency_summary: Report lookup and update tails, bytes, CPU time, and the 100-times target gap.
field_principles.memory_state_manifest: Hash before and after active masks, archives, certificates, and bytes.
field_principles.methodology: State the CPU replay, authority boundary, and independent-unit method.
field_principles.milestone: Bind the result to the V637 recurrence-learning roadmap item.
field_principles.model_invoked: Describe only current execution; historical sources are separate.
field_principles.no_model_weight_mutation: The opt-in memory experiment must not alter model weights.
field_principles.operation_receipts_path: Retain measured query, delivery, validation, switch, and write receipts.
field_principles.paired_seed_rows: Keep 32 independent stream units per arm with efficacy and cost metrics.
field_principles.phase_spans_s: Retain measured monotonic time for each numbered work phase.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Observe paths, resources, identity, hashes, and quarantine before replay.
field_principles.publication_performed: This task does not publish, upload, or submit results.
field_principles.random_seed: Freeze stream and bootstrap schedules before evaluation labels are observed.
field_principles.recurrence_learning_value_score: One means all causal, recurrence, safety, and error gates pass.
field_principles.recurrence_run_complete_score: One means all scheduled event-and-arm outcomes are accounted for.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Hash exact settings, inputs, gates, and raw-row receipts.
field_principles.rows: Retain one comparison row for every independent stream and arm.
field_principles.run_date: Use 20260912; retain actual UTC start and end timestamps.
field_principles.sample_size_budget: Predeclare units, attempts, completions, censoring, and stopping.
field_principles.schema: Version the artifact and bind experiment_id and milestone to this task.
field_principles.sidecar_write_receipts: Measure and hash each durable raw or state sidecar write.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Hash source code, public inputs, private inputs, and raw outputs.
field_principles.started_at_utc: Keep the actual UTC start separate from the fixed execution date.
field_principles.status: Terminal complete or blocked only; unfinished work uses a separate checkpoint path.
field_principles.stream_contract: Bind separated labels, delays, warmup, recurrence, and controller inputs.
field_principles.verdict_class: Use exactly positive, circular_positive, null, blocked, disqualified, or partial.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: True because the exact evaluator also defines correctness.

honest_verdict: complete_null: validated archive reuse did not pass every frozen learning gate

methodology.held_out_authority: private evaluator joined after prediction and query receipts

sample_size_budget.stopping_rule: all predeclared streams once; no outcome-based extension
